Java Developer, CartNest — Feb 2026 - Present

Designed REST APIs and async integration with payment providers using Apache Kafka and SQS for decoupled processing. Contributed to CI/CD and observability, reducing median deploy time by 35% and improving service restart resilience on Kubernetes-like orchestration. Collaborated on architecture docs in Confluence.

Containerized applications with Docker and ran workloads on Kubernetes clusters for blue/green deployments. Implemented retry and backpressure strategies for Kafka consumers, integrated with S3 for batch export and EC2-based workers for heavy processing. Authored runbooks and design notes in Confluence.

Software Engineer, Zoho — Aug 2024 - May 2025
Developed Spring Boot microservices in Java for internal platform features, using Hibernate for persistence and Kafka for event-driven interactions. Containerized services with Docker and participated in Kubernetes deployments and capacity tuning. Implemented logging and monitoring on Linux hosts and coordinated merges and design reviews in Confluence.
